known_issues: User cannot add products (product creation flow failing).

existing_features.title: Ensure the frontend inventory create flow surfaces backend errors clearly when product creation fails, and prevents obviously invalid submissions (e.g., empty required fields or non-numeric values) before calling the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix backend authorization so authenticated users can create inventory products successfully, even when access control has not been explicitly initialized with an admin secret token.
Add backend-side input validation and clearer trap messages for inventory item creation so the UI can surface actionable errors (e.g., missing required fields, invalid numeric values).

projectName: Fix inability to add inventory products (authorization + validation)
